notes.title: A new laser has arrived
notes.content:
Hey Explorers,
Here’s a new update with some polish, balance and new features, getting ready for a cool new feature:

[list]
[*]     Fixed hoverbike layering issues.
[*]     Increased the price of medkits in shops.
[*]     Ruined houses now occasionally host companions for hire.
[*]     Pacified planets will also unlock their maps.
[*]     Implemented a new laser weapon for the player.
[*]     Companions now teleport to the player if left behind for a long time.
[*]     Introduced new setups for the electricity hacking mini-game.
[*]     Fixed various story-related issues.
[*]     The lantern now illuminates the floor layer, adding mystery.
[*]     Pyramids on planets can now be entered.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43806868/9a8a9c7497ba9e85b7c42c8676019833377c6486.gif[/img]
[*]     More cave entrances, such as those near statues, can now be found on planets.
[*]     Added more Spanish translations to tutorials.
[*]     Introduced lily pads on water surfaces.
[*]     Increased the chromatic aberration effect on planets.
[*]     Improved transparency for trees.
[*]     Different types of companions can now be hired on planets.
[*]     Gun prices in shops now vary based on rarity and planet.
[*]     Dashing now consumes energy.
[*]     Added shooting offsets for enemies and companions.
[*]     Introduced loot with traps.
[*]     Dashing now costs energy.
[*] 
[/list]

Thank you for being there!

Jorge

notes.title: Sell your stuff!
notes.content:
Hi explorers

[list]
[*] You can now sell loot on shops you will find around planets
[*] Brought down spacestation floors brightness
[*] Added space whales as props on planets
[*] When you exit and you are on a planet you will be in the planet next time you load your game
[*] Enemy settlements now are displayed on the planet map with an E
[*] Freighters have thrust now
[*] Changed ship control sprite
[/list]

Fixed:
[list]
[*] Endless price discount
[*] Spamming exit on planet when in a ship
[*] Entering freighter at the same time as landing on a planet 
[/list]

Thank you for playing and signing up to the playtest

Jorge
